description: This file contains unit tests for the RttStats class in the QUIC congestion control module, verifying RTT measurement, smoothing, min RTT, connection migration reset, and standard deviation calculations.

classes.name: RttStatsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for RTT statistics tests, inheriting from QuicTest.

methods.name: DefaultsBeforeUpdate
methods.description: Tests default RTT values before any updates.

methods.name: SmoothedRtt
methods.description: Verifies RTT smoothing behavior with various updates.

methods.name: SmoothedRttStability
methods.description: Checks that smoothed RTT remains stable over multiple updates.

methods.name: PreviousSmoothedRtt
methods.description: Tests correctness of previous smoothed RTT after updates.

methods.name: MinRtt
methods.description: Verifies minimum RTT tracking over multiple updates.

methods.name: ExpireSmoothedMetrics
methods.description: Tests expiration logic for smoothed RTT and deviation.

methods.name: UpdateRttWithBadSendDeltas
methods.description: Ensures invalid RTT updates are rejected.

methods.name: ResetAfterConnectionMigrations
methods.description: Verifies RTT reset behavior after connection migration.
